description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Headhunter, adding {B}.
When Headhunter dies, Yedora triggers, returning Headhunter from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Headhunter by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Headhunter's morph ability by paying {B}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
